description: CampusFind 2.0 - Smart Campus Lost & Found Management Platform REST API

scripts.free-port: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const p = process.env.PORT || 5000; try { if (process.platform === 'win32') { const out = execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :' + p).toString(); out.trim().split('\n').forEach(l => { const pid = l.trim().split(/\s+/).pop(); if (pid && /^\d+$/.test(pid) && pid !== '0') { try { execSync('taskkill /PID ' + pid + ' /F'); console.log('Killed PID ' + pid + ' on port ' + p); } catch(e){} } }); } else { execSync('lsof -ti :' + p + ' | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null'); } console.log('Port ' + p + ' is now free.'); } catch(e) { console.log('Port ' + p + ' is already free.'); }"

author: CampusFind Development Team
